# Arteparquet.pro - AI Context File
# Last updated: 2026-08-31

## About This Business
Arteparquet is a professional flooring company based in Bergamo, Italy, specializing in hardwood floor installation, sanding, and restoration since 1996. The founder, Mohamed Arabi, was part of the professional team that worked on Teatro alla Scala in Milan in 2004.

## Core Services
- Hardwood floor installation (posa parquet) - solid wood and engineered
- Floor sanding without dust (levigatura parquet senza polvere)
- Antique floor restoration (restauro parquet antico)
- Floor repairs (riparazione parquet)
- SPC/LVT/Vinyl flooring installation (pavimenti SPC e PVC)
- Laminate flooring

## Service Area
Primary: Bergamo and province (Lombardy, Italy)
Extended: Milan, Brescia, Como, Monza, Varese, Lecco, Lodi, Pavia, Cremona, Mantova

## Technical Expertise
- Professional dust-free sanding machines with integrated vacuum systems
- Moisture measurement with carbide hygrometer (max 2% for cement screed)
- UV-cured and oil finishes
- Herringbone patterns (Italian and French)
- Custom inlays and borders
